query:
SELECT o.path AS "path!", o.storedir AS "storedir!"
              FROM buildsteps s
              JOIN buildstepoutputs o
                  ON s.build = o.build AND s.stepnr = o.stepnr
              WHERE s.drvPath = $1
                AND o.name = $2
                AND o.path IS NOT NULL
                AND s.status = 0
              -- `+ 0`: see resolve_drv_output_chains.
              ORDER BY s.build + 0 DESC
              LIMIT 1
